snippet.title: Silent Noise Prologue | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the haunting world of Silent Noise Prologue, a psychological horror experience crafted by MSP Games.

You play as David, an 18-year-old boy burdened by the trauma of losing his father at the age of five. With his mother terminally ill and in desperate need of medicine, David takes up a night-shift security job. But the silence of the night hides unsettling mysteries, and every shadow whispers a chilling story.

This official launch trailer offers a first glimpse into the immersive narrative, atmospheric visuals, and multi-language support (English, Hindi, Japanese) that define Silent Noise.
